prompt_scaffold: Create a state-aware left-three-quarter office portrait that preserves the approved wolf identity, the cyan subject-left ear stud, the healed outer ear-tip notch, cyan eyes, and paired cheek wedges. Show professional composure masking fear through shallow breath, slight temple sweat, and tension concentrated in the left hand. Keep the shirt closed and dry, place the left hand against the desk edge, and use warm window light with cool interior fill in the polished soft-cel style family.
